description: This Java source file `BitmapScaling.java` demonstrates how to load and display scaled versions of a bitmap image using `BitmapFactory.Options.inSampleSize`. It creates an activity that shows the original image and several scaled-down versions by adjusting the sample size parameter.

classes.name: BitmapScaling
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates bitmap scaling with inSampleSize options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the original bitmap, and creates scaled images with different sample sizes.

methods.name: addScaledImageView
methods.description: Creates a scaled bitmap using inSampleSize, wraps it in an ImageView, and adds it to the container layout.
